name: maintenance
description: Purpose agent maintenance he thong Viezan: diagnostics, duplicate/hardcode, score-code, UI/component/extension drift, docs drift, security/i18n/perf gates, fix va bao cao tong hop co section bat buoc.

classification.use_for: Use when the user asks to maintain the system, clean up technical debt, fix diagnostics, or run a broad quality pass.

activation_examples: Bao tri source code hien tai
Kiem tra va fix cac van de chat luong code

relationship_model: agent -> maintenance workflow -> diagnostic, score, duplicate, UI, docs, i18n, security, extension, live-perf and release gates
workflow -> rules/skills used by each gate
skill -> domain rubric/checklist and false-positive policy
rule -> guardrail applied while fixing Critical/High findings
requirements: Resolve primary_workflow, mandatory_gates and all referenced capabilities before reporting maintenance status.
Do not replace score-code, check-dup-hardcode or split-ui-component with ad hoc scans.
Use only declared capabilities unless the user asks to add a new maintenance capability.
If any required gate capability is missing or blocked, mark it Blocked and include it in Remaining Queue.

conditional.when: chrome-extension/ or browser bridge is in scope
Live Translate, audio, streaming, subtitle, timers or listeners are in scope
package, version, CI, signing, notarization or distribution assets are in scope

mandatory_gates.name: Repo scope
mandatory_gates.required_output: Branch/submodule/dirty-state summary and explicit maintenance scope.

mandatory_gates.name: Diagnostics
mandatory_gates.required_output: Command/status table for build, renderer/electron typecheck, tests and Biome or VS Code diagnostics.

mandatory_gates.name: System Score
mandatory_gates.required_output: Viezan Electron rubric score table with weighted total, evidence and point deductions.

mandatory_gates.name: Duplicate Code Audit
mandatory_gates.required_output: Duplicate summary by clone type and severity, top repeated files or explicit clean result.

mandatory_gates.name: Hardcode & Secret Audit
mandatory_gates.required_output: Hardcode/secret/magic literal summary by category and severity, including false-positive notes.

mandatory_gates.name: UI/Component/Extension Audit
mandatory_gates.required_output: Component classification, inline SVG/icon, duplicate UI pattern and extension UI drift summary.

mandatory_gates.name: Docs/I18n/Security Gates
mandatory_gates.required_output: Docs drift, locale parity/hardcoded UI text and local-first security result.

mandatory_gates.name: Live/Performance Gate
mandatory_gates.required_output: Lifecycle/performance result when live translate, audio, streaming or timer/listener code is in scope.

mandatory_gates.name: Release Readiness
mandatory_gates.required_output: Release/package gate result when package, version, CI or distribution assets are in scope.

operating_workflow.action: Read repo state, recent reports and user scope; do not reset unrelated dirty files.
Run or consume build/test/Biome/VS Code diagnostics and classify root causes.
Run duplicate/hardcode, score-code and UI component capabilities; dedupe false positives; keep separate evidence buckets for scoring, duplicate, hardcode and UI.
Run docs, i18n and local-first security checks as gates; run live-perf when live/audio/streaming code is in scope; release readiness only when release/package scope is present.
Fix Critical/High findings in scope, keep reports synchronized and avoid broad redesign.
Write a consolidated maintenance report with all mandatory sections. If a gate was skipped, write Not run/Blocked with a reason instead of omitting it.

minimum_evidence: Every mandatory gate appears in Maintenance Gate Matrix.
System Score includes weighted total and per-criterion rows.
Duplicate Code Audit and Hardcode & Secret Audit are separate sections.
UI/Component/Extension Audit names inspected surfaces and any false-positive rules used.
Verification lists commands actually run, not generic validation claims.

completion_rules: A maintenance report is incomplete if any mandatory gate is omitted.
A clean result still needs a short evidence line explaining what was checked.
Do not collapse score-code, check-dup-hardcode and split-ui-component into a single generic Findings row.
Do not claim a gate passed from static intuition; cite commands, files scanned or report artifacts.
If time or environment prevents a gate from running, mark it Blocked or Not run and add it to Remaining Queue.
